name: Sheela Foam Limited
summary: Sheela Foam Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of polyurethane foams and mattresses in India and internationally. The company provides technical foams, such as automotive, reticulated, sound absorption, visco-elastic, resilience, stable, silentech and ultraviolet stable foams, as well as specialty foams. It also offers comfort foam and home care products, consisting foam sheets, foam blocks, comfort range accessories, foam cores, bed sheets, pillows, and furniture cushioning products; and furniture foams and products.
